ICS: Use language and terminology that is appropriate for the patient.
Find out what the patient already knows and is experiencing.
Describe the facts of the adverse event and its outcome known at the time.
Describe the steps that were and will be taken in the care of the patient.
Clarify whether the information is understood.
Using active listening skills to help understand the patient’s experiences and needs.
Conveying this also with body language/eye contact.
Sit at eye level/do not dominate.
Speak at a comfortably slow rate.
PROF: Adopting an open, forthright and sincere approach.
